Short title and commencement

ACT XXVIII OF 1975
ACT XXVIII OF 1975
PORTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Ports Act, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th March 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 1st March 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Ports (Amendment) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into sorce at
once.

Amendment of section 21, Act XV of 1908

ACT XXVIII OF 1975
ACT XXVIII OF 1975
PORTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Ports Act, 1908
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th March 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 1st March 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 21,
Act XV of 1908.---In the Ports Act, 1908 (XV of 1908), hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, in section 21,-
(a) in subsection (1), after the
words "in or into", the commas and words "or in any place from
which the same is liable to be washed as aforesaid into" shall be inserted
;
(b) in subsection (2), for the
words "five hundred" the words "fifty thousand" shall be
substituted ; and
(c) in subsection (3), for the
words "also be liable to simple imprison anent for a term which may extend
to two months" the words "be punishable with a further fine which may
extend to two thousand rupees for each day after the receipt of such notice and
also be liable to simple imprisonment for a team which may extend to six
months" shall be substituted.
